        sandbox.add_beam(12.5, 3.0, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density),
        sandbox.add_beam(12.5, 4.0, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density),
        sandbox.add_beam(12.5, 6.0, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density)
    ]
    
    # Create beams in right strip [13.4, 13.6]
    beams_right = [
        sandbox.add_beam(13.5, 1.0, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density),

        sandbox.add_beam(13.5, 6.5, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density)

    # Create middle strip beam [12.9, 13.1]
    beam_middle = sandbox.add_beam(13.0, 3.0, beam_width, beam_height, density=beam_density)
